correctness.rationale: For the real six-vertex weighted cycle w=(1,2,2,2,2,2), Lipschitz dual ball equals zero-sum weighted-edge increment section. Every dual vertex has at least five edge constraints saturated and comes from fixing five signs; exactly 60 vertices. The primal ball has exactly 12 signed normalized edge molecules, each exposed because its edge is strictly shorter than its complementary path. The finite extreme-pair numerical-radius principle reduces operator norm to 360 unique rank-one tensors and numerical radius to 150 norming-contact tensors. FROZEN actual `c6_exact_certificate.json` (Git blob 588e48168e1d6266873c94c2bf63ea16373f7cb2) and `c6_verify_exact.py` (blob 715f609c54b818c4eff2196d10e4c3d47b5cecfe) were inspected. Independent custom exact BigInt rational reconstruction regenerated all 60 dual,12 primal,150 contacts,360 norm tensors; equality with stored full sets held, all 360 certificate rational linear decompositions matched coordinatewise with ℓ1 coefficient sums ≤17/14 (zero failures), and the explicit 5x5 witness had v(T)=1 and ||T||=17/14. This is mathematically exhaustive because the vertex enumeration and reduction are proved, not a sample. Thus n(X)=14/17 exactly.
residual_risks: Applies only to real free space over exactly this five-dimensional six-point weighted metric; does not imply a complete weighted-cycle classification.
